title: 第3章 便宜老娘与十年第4章 十年成长
slug: 朝廷鹰犬没挨过六扇门的刀
content_zh:
便宜老娘与十年。
秋落院。
“哎哟~还记得回家啊，我还以为你是嫡子了呢。”何穗看着出现在院子门口的李君肃，抑扬顿挫的开口。
“娘，谢谢你给我留饭。”李君肃看着桌上还有馀温的饭菜，走近。
对於自家便宜老娘矛盾又纠结的心思，他已经习惯了。
好在因为自己的若有似无的影响下，自家便宜老娘的心态已经不像以前那样尖锐了。
“算你还是个有良心的，天天跟他们玩什麽？
你要”何穗下意识又要开口刺人。
“娘，我叫莫念，字慎行。”李君肃淡淡开口。
场面一时又安静下来。
半晌。
“对不起。”何穗看着背着光的小小人影，近乎无声的开口道歉。
她的道歉诚恳又无力。
如果说一开始因为怀孕而被抬为妾室的她是惊喜交加的话，等到李君肃真真正正降生之後，她反而有点後悔了。
李君肃一岁能说会道，两岁已经开始识字了。
三岁已经开始缠着老爷追问武道之事，今年开始淬筋锻骨。
聪颖好学，待下人温和有礼。
而且，李君肃有不属於这个年龄的懂礼。
一举一动，都比李君豪更像李家嫡子。
很多时候，族老都是惋惜李君肃为什麽不是嫡子。

何穗因此洋洋自得，可是李君肃一席话让她的得意烟消云散。
“娘，因为我知道我自己应该待在什麽位置，所以族老他们愿意吹捧我，让我给大哥大姐当个榜样。”李君肃翻着书，慢条斯理的说道。
“可如果我有什麽异心，我们两人的下场就只有死。”李君肃平淡的翻过书页，语气却让何穗如梦初醒。
“娘，我叫莫念，字慎行。”李君肃抬起头，脸上是不属於孩童的平淡神情。
“娘，我吃饱了，午憩去了。”何穗被温和的声音唤回神。
“嗯，去吧。”何穗不敢看李君肃，低着头，轻声呢喃着。
“娘，你也要注意休息。”李君肃轻声说着。
“收拾吧。”等到李君肃走後，何穗看着已经收拾的整整齐齐的餐具，有些疲惫的揉着眉心。
“休息，练武，争取早日登堂。”李君肃在床上盘腿而坐，想着。
武道与仙道，淬筋锻骨后统一为登堂丶入室丶宗法丶大家丶观山丶望海。
再往上的境界，李家的资料就没有了。
“观山望海倒是贴合。”李君肃笑着，缓缓闭上眼睛，开始打坐。
日子就这麽一天一天的过去了。
第一年。
登堂，清风城震动。
李家庶子比林家大少爷六岁登堂的记录还要让人震惊。
五岁的登堂境，很多人都觉得自己活到狗肚子里去了。
登堂，顾名思义，体内已经开始积蓄灵力或内力了。
五岁，五岁就开始积蓄内力，等到他日长成，该有多麽妖孽，多麽耀眼。
震动过後，大家都打算在宴席上好好看看李家嫡子跟正房的笑话。

庶子是妖孽，你这正房又当如何？
而後，清风城的人都失望了，李家的氛围出奇的好。
甚至於那庶子全场居然是在正房夫人的膝盖上度过这场宴席的。
content_en:
Cheap old lady and ten years.
Autumn falls in the courtyard.
"Oh~ I still remember to go home. I thought you were the legitimate son." He Sui looked at Li Junsu who appeared at the door of the yard and spoke in a measured tone.
"Mom, thank you for leaving food for me." Li Junsu looked at the warm food on the table and walked closer.
He was used to his cheap wife's contradictory and entangled thoughts.
Fortunately, due to the influence of my own insecurities, my cheap wife's mentality is no longer as sharp as before.
"You are still a conscientious person, why do you play with them every day?
"You want to" He Sui subconsciously wanted to stab someone again.
"Mom, my name is Mo Nian, and my courtesy name is Shenxing." Li Junsu said calmly.
The scene became quiet again for a while.
A long while.
"I'm sorry." He Sui looked at the small figure with the light behind him and apologized almost silently.
Her apology was sincere but feeble.
If she was pleasantly surprised at first being taken as a concubine because of her pregnancy, she actually regretted it after Li Junsu was actually born.
Li Junsu was eloquent at one year old and started to read at two years old.
At the age of three, he has already begun to pester his master about martial arts. This year, he began to temper his muscles and bones.
Smart and eager to learn, gentle and polite to others.
Moreover, Li Junsu has a sense of etiquette that is beyond his age.
In every move he makes, he looks more like the legitimate son of the Li family than Li Junhao.
Many times, clan elders regretted why Li Junsu was not the legitimate son.
He Sui was so proud of this, but Li Junsu's words made her pride disappear.
"Mom, because I know where I should be, the clan elders are willing to praise me and let me be a role model for my elder brothers and sisters." Li Junsu said slowly while flipping through the book.
"But if I have any different intentions, the two of us will only die." Li Junsu turned the pages of the book calmly, but his tone made He Sui wake up from a dream.
"Mom, my name is Mo Nian, and my courtesy name is Shenxing." Li Junsu raised his head, with a calm expression that did not belong to a child.
"Mom, I'm full and I'm going to take a nap." He Sui was brought back to consciousness by a gentle voice.
"Well, go ahead." He Sui didn't dare to look at Li Junsu, lowered his head and murmured softly.
"Mom, you should also pay attention to rest." Li Junsu said softly.
"Put it away." After Li Junsu left, He Sui looked at the neatly packed tableware and rubbed his brows tiredly.
"Rest, practice martial arts, and strive to be in court as soon as possible." Li Junsu was sitting cross-legged on the bed, thinking.
Martial arts and immortality, after tempering the muscles and forging the bones, are unified into entering the hall, entering the house, paying homage to the clan, everyone, watching the mountains, and looking at the sea.
In the higher realms, there is no information about the Li family.
"Viewing the mountains and the sea is quite suitable." Li Junsu smiled, slowly closed his eyes, and began to meditate.
The days passed like this day by day.
First year.
Entering the hall, Qingfeng City was shocked.
The record of the concubine of the Li family being even more shocking than the eldest son of the Lin family who entered the court at the age of six.
At the age of five, many people feel like they have lived in a dog's belly when they reach the Dengtang state.
Dengtang, as the name suggests, has begun to accumulate spiritual power or internal power in the body.
At the age of five, he began to accumulate internal strength at the age of five. When he grows up, he will be so monster and dazzling.
After the shock, everyone planned to watch the joke between the legitimate son of the Li family and the first wife at the banquet.
The concubine is a monster, so what do you think of me as the principal wife?
After that, everyone in Qingfeng City was disappointed, and the atmosphere in the Li family was surprisingly good.
The concubine actually spent the entire banquet on the lap of the principal wife.
